mapper.delete: DELETE FROM field_mapping WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO field_mapping (doc_id, internal_field_id, lender_field_name, lender_value, source_quote, confidence, status) VALUES
(#{r.docId}, #{r.internalFieldId}, #{r.lenderFieldName}, #{r.lenderValue}, #{r.sourceQuote}, #{r.confidence}, 'PENDING')
ON CONFLICT (doc_id, internal_field_id) DO UPDATE SET lender_field_name = EXCLUDED.lender_field_name, lender_value = EXCLUDED.lender_value, source_quote = EXCLUDED.source_quote, confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence, status = 'PENDING' WHERE field_mapping.status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT id, doc_id, internal_field_id, COALESCE(lender_field_name, '') AS lender_field_name, COALESCE(lender_value, '') AS lender_value, COALESCE(source_quote, '') AS source_quote, confidence, status FROM field_mapping WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY internal_field_id
SELECT doc_id, internal_field_id, lender_field_name, lender_value, source_quote, confidence FROM field_mapping WHERE doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY internal_field_id
mapper.update: UPDATE field_mapping SET lender_value = COALESCE(#{correctedValue}, lender_value), lender_field_name = COALESCE(#{correctedFieldName}, lender_field_name), status = 'CORRECTED' WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND internal_field_id = #{internalFieldId}
UPDATE field_mapping SET status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND internal_field_id = #{internalFieldId}
